notes: What android-host reads from the theme component. The shell holds no colours: the application builds a ShellPalette from the theme palette.

ThemeSet.palette.returns: ThemePalette(primary,secondary,background,surface,onPrimary: Long 0xAARRGGBB); copy the five fields into ShellPalette

parseColour.returns: Long? (0xAARRGGBB); android-host has the same function for reading #rrggbb text
